# `matchBooleanToIsSuccess`

Suggests Effect.isSuccess or Effect.isFailure when Effect.match or Effect.matchEager folds to complementary boolean literals

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377173`, `TS377174` |
| Language Service name | `matchBooleanToIsSuccess` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/match-boolean-to-is-success` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const saveUser: Effect.Effect<void, Error>

export const saved = Effect.match(saveUser, {
/**
                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(match-boolean-to-is-success): `Effect.isSuccess` expresses this check more directly than `Effect.match` folding to complementary boolean literals.
*/
  onFailure: () => false,
  onSuccess: () => true
})
```
